Strings
*******

A string holds text.


Making strings
==============

Write a string between quotes.

class text(value='')

   A piece of text.

   upper()

      Return the text in capitals.

         >>> text('a').upper()
         'A'

   text.count(sub)
   text.tally(sub)

      Count how often *sub* occurs.

text.join(parts)

   Join *parts* with the text between them.


Lines
=====

+--------+---------+
| Break  | Meaning |
|========|=========|
| "\n"   | line    |
+--------+---------+

Lines end at a line break & never <here>.

   An indented example.


Lines
=====

A second title with the same words.
